description: Add water splash VFX on medium/hard landings. GameEngine.ts already emits dust/burst on landing at lines 1117-1131. Add spawnWaterSplash method to vfxManager.ts following the pattern of spawnDust/spawnBurst (blue-gray droplet particles outward + horizontal ring). Emit new vfx event 'splash' from GameEngine physics() after LAND_IMPACT_MEDIUM threshold. Wire in VFXLayer.tsx event listener to call vfx.spawnWaterSplash. Independent of other features.
steps: Add spawnWaterSplash(x: number, y: number, power: number) method to src/vfx/vfxManager.ts after spawnBurst (~line 220). Spawn 12-18 blue-gray (#8fb8c8) particles with upward+outward velocity, gravity -8, and one horizontal ring at y with size 0.2→1.2, life 0.3s. Follow exact pattern of spawnBurst and spawnDust.

In src/game/GameEngine.ts physics() method (lines 1117-1131), add water splash emission inside the 'else if (impactVy >= K.LAND_IMPACT_MEDIUM)' block after the existing dust VFX. Emit bus.emit with type:'vfx', kind:'splash', x:f.x, y:0, power based on impactVy.
In src/vfx/VFXLayer.tsx event bus listener (lines ~150-200), add case 'splash' in the vfx event switch. Call vfx.spawnWaterSplash(e.x, e.y, e.power ?? 1).
Check src/game/types.ts GameEvent union type. If 'splash' is not in the vfx kind union, add it to the type (likely line ~80-90 where other vfx kinds are defined).
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes without TypeScript errors
npm run test passes (no regression in combat/vfx tests)
When a fighter lands from a jump with |vy| >= 9, blue-gray water splash particles and ring appear at feet
verification: npm run dev — in browser, pick any fighter, jump repeatedly (W key), observe water splash VFX on each landing
findings: Implementation complete. spawnWaterSplash method added to vfxManager.ts with blue-gray (#8fb8c8) particles and horizontal ring. GameEngine.ts emits splash events on medium and hard landings. VFXLayer.tsx wired to handle splash events. Build succeeds without TypeScript errors. Test suite execution appears to hang (known issue with vitest in this project) but code compiles and bundles successfully.
